name: 15201 · Pittsburgh, PA
findings: ZIP 15201 (Pittsburgh) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15201 (Pittsburgh) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15201 (Pittsburgh) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
